title: Measure the capture and the digest
question: what does the console capture actually hand to captureErrorPayload, what shape is extension/error-digest.json, and what is not captured?
verdict: the capture is narrower than the roadmap's sentence: three entry points (the console.error wrapper, the window error event, unhandledrejection) feed one four-key payload, and of the ten console methods measured only console.error is mentioned anywhere in extension/agent-main.js; the code a message carries is whatever the shipped /NG0\d{3,}/ regex finds, so 11 of the digest's 64 codes can never arrive as a code while 53 can, and 45 of the 64 digest bodies are already cut off with the trim marker

code.rule: the first /NG0\d{3,}/ match in the text, else null (2502-2503)

codeExtraction.nullWhen: no match, which is dispatched as code: null and never invented

text.meaning: 45 of the 64 bodies are already cut off and end with the generator's trim marker character (U+2026), and 62 of the 64 titles repeat the opening words of their own body, so a title adds no fact the body lacks

digest.statedInProse: the shipped digest is 61577 bytes over 326 lines and 61450 characters, carrying 64 entries

notCaptured.what: every console method except console.error — warn, log, info, debug, trace, dir, table, assert, group
notCaptured.evidence: c3 counts 0 mentions of each of those nine methods in extension/agent-main.js, while the only console method the file assigns is console.error at line 2536
notCaptured.consequence: a page whose only diagnostic is a console.warn or console.log produces no capture event at all; the join can only ever see what these three hooks dispatch

notCaptured.what: the 11 digest codes that are not NG0 followed by at least three digits
notCaptured.evidence: c9: 53 of 64 codes are extractable by the shipped regex and 11 are not (NG1001, NG2003, NG2009, NG3003, NG6100, NG8001, NG8002, NG8003, NG8011, NG8023, NG8024); c7 shows the regex returning null for the sample NG8008
notCaptured.consequence: a page that logs one of those message texts verbatim reaches the join as a message carrying no code, so those 11 digest entries can never be selected by the capture's own extraction

notCaptured.what: a lowercase or mixed-case code in message text
notCaptured.evidence: c7: 'ng0100 -> null' and the same for a mixed-case spelling, against 'NG0100 -> NG0100'; c9: all 64 digest codes are already uppercase (codesEqualToTheirUppercase 64)
notCaptured.consequence: an exact-string join is total over the capture's own code space, but a lowercased code in a message is not extracted as a code at all, so case folding can never rescue it at join time

notCaptured.what: the logged arguments as values, and any object inside them
notCaptured.evidence: c4 line 2538 joins the arguments with a single space before capture, and c6 shows the payload's only text key is message
notCaptured.consequence: an object argument arrives as its string form and no argument can be recovered separately; the join has one string per diagnostic and nothing structured to inspect

notCaptured.what: where the diagnostic was logged — no url, line, column, stack or phase
notCaptured.evidence: c6: the payload has exactly four keys, code, message, component and timestamp, and no field carries a source location; the digest entry carries none either (c8)
notCaptured.consequence: the panel cannot name a file, a line or an element, which is consistent with the interface contract's exclusion of an element reference

notCaptured.what: which component actually emitted the message
notCaptured.evidence: c4 2507-2514 probes document.activeElement, then app-root, then body, then documentElement, and resolves that element rather than the call site; 2505 and 2518-2520 leave the field null when the page exposes no resolver or it throws
notCaptured.consequence: component may be null, and when present it names the component owning the focused element or the app root, not necessarily the one that logged

notCaptured.what: any digest fact beyond code, title and body — no cause, element, remedy, severity or message text
notCaptured.evidence: c8: one entry key set, body,code,title, with all three fields typed string; c9: 45 of 64 bodies are already trimmed and 62 titles repeat their body's opening words
notCaptured.consequence: a finding can carry only the digest's title and the capture's own message; the exclusion of cause, element and remedy is structural in the data, not only a rendering choice

notCaptured.what: every diagnostic logged before extension/agent-main.js is injected at document_idle — including bootstrap-time NG0xxx codes, the errors this milestone exists to join — and, separately, any diagnostic logged after the page replaces console.error or through a reference saved from the original console.error
notCaptured.evidence: c14: extension/manifest.json:36 injects extension/agent-main.js with "run_at": "document_idle" — the second content_scripts entry (:29-38), the only entry whose js lists agent-main.js (:34), world MAIN (:37); the only run_at document_start in the file is the overlay (:39-49, :48), and c14 counts one mention of each. extension/agent-main.js:2493 comments "error capture hooks at document_start", which the manifest contradicts. c5 shows one assignment to console.error (2536) and one saved original (2535), inside a single install block (2533-2543) evaluated once and never repeated
notCaptured.consequence: the capture does not exist for the part of bootstrap that runs before document_idle, so a page that logs an NG0xxx error there produces no capture event for it and the join can only report diagnostics logged after the injection; a later override or a saved reference bypasses the hook silently

notCaptured.evidence: c4: the dispatch sits inside captureErrorPayload's try (2522-2527) and every path falls into catch with the comment never throw (2528-2530)
notCaptured.consequence: a diagnostic whose capture throws emits no event and is indistinguishable, from the panel's side, from a page that logged nothing — captured-nothing cannot be read as a claim that the page was silent

notCaptured.what: a diagnostic emitted in another frame or another global
notCaptured.evidence: c5: both event hooks are registered on globalThis (2550, 2557) and the console hook patches this realm's console (2534-2536); no payload key carries a frame or window identity (c6)
notCaptured.consequence: output from a nested frame is not captured by these lines, and if it were it could not be attributed to a frame

captureToDigestGap.note: the 53 digest codes the capture's /NG0\d{3,}/ can extract are a strict subset of the digest's 64 (c9), so 11 digest codes can never arrive as a code; the relation does not run the other way — NG04002 is extractable by the capture's regex (c7) and absent from all 64 digest entries (c8, c11), so the capture can produce a code the digest lacks and the join's no-digest-entry path is exercisable against the shipped digest. A message carrying one of the 11 non-NG0 codes arrives as a finding with no code

rules: reason is present only when the digest lacks the code the message carried
code is absent only when the message carried none
the panel renders state and findings and nothing else: no cause, element, remedy or unattributed wording
joinContract.notRecordedHere: the surface's per-case { state, findings[] } belongs to the task that writes the join; this file records only the two input shapes it reads, so that record can be asserted against these shapes without re-deriving them
